causes.label: demand
causes.quote: The temperature in Sydney reached 37 degrees, four degrees higher than that forecast the previous day. This resulted in the demand reaching a maximum of 12 163MW at 4 pm.

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Planned generator outages across New South Wales and plant problems at Eraring power station on the day resulted in a tight supply-demand balance in New South Wales.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: At around 3.30 pm, Eraring unit three tripped from around 430 MW.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: Rebidding into higher prices by Stanwell combined with increased exports from Queensland led to the dispatch of high priced generation in Queensland.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: Flows across the Victoria to New South Wales interconnector exceeded the import limit during the 3.35 pm to 3.45 pm dispatch intervals.

causes.label: constraint_violation
causes.quote: The 5 minute dispatch price in New South Wales was capped at $10 000/MWh for the 3.35 pm and 3.40 pm dispatch intervals.

constraints_named.quote: The reason given was "1532 Transmission Constraint-QNI STH Price Separation".

interconnectors_named.name: Victoria to New South Wales interconnector
interconnectors_named.quote: Flows across the Victoria to New South Wales interconnector exceeded the import limit during the 3.35 pm to 3.45 pm dispatch intervals.

interconnectors_named.name: Queensland to New South Wales interconnectors
interconnectors_named.quote: Combined flows across the Queensland to New South Wales interconnectors were around 1200 MW, close to their total nominal limit but around 340 MW higher than forecast four hours ahead.

intervals.quote: On 3 November 2009, the spot price in New South Wales and Queensland exceeded $5000/MWh for the 4 pm trading interval, reaching $6337/MWh and $5706/MWh respectively.
